dct_description_sm:
Building Rooflines data are delivered as part of our Aerial Photo acquisition project.  The building rooflines are based on aerial photos flown in the summer (typically dates in May/June/July).  They are digitized stereoscopically to correct for building lean and should be in their true location, which is why they don't always visually align with building rooftops on our aerial photo.  We usually acquire updated building rooflines every 2 years (on odd numbered years) as part of our Aerial Photo project.
 
The 2025 Rooflines are based on aerial photos captured May 28, 2025.
 
Note: Attributes represent each field in a dataset, and some fields will contain information such as ID numbers.  As a result some visualizations on the tabs on our Open Data page will not be relevant.
